_readme: Homepage and International showcase content (who we help, the need selector, concept demos, the project process). Prices are never written here: they come from services.json / pricing.json (India) and international.json (USD). Real work lives in international.json -> portfolio. Every concept demo must say 'Concept demo' and 'not client work' (build.py checks).

concepts.title: A local shop page people can act on
concepts.alt_before: Before: a cluttered page for a fictional hardware shop with no opening hours, no clear buttons and a phone number hidden inside a banner image.
concepts.alt_after: After: the same fictional shop with today's opening hours, WhatsApp, call and directions buttons, a four-part catalogue and a note on how to ask for prices.
shows: Opening hours and location at the top
A short catalogue instead of a wall of text

concepts.title: A clinic page with honest appointment options
concepts.alt: A fictional dental clinic page listing three services with visit lengths, and an appointments panel offering online booking through the clinic's own system or a call-back request, noting that a request is not a confirmed booking.
shows: Online booking goes to the clinic's existing system
A call-back request is clearly not a confirmed booking
No patient records or medical details collected

concepts.title: A tutorial storyboard for a software product
concepts.alt: A storyboard for a fictional app's getting-started tutorial: three screens with the clicked control highlighted, a caption under each, timed narration lines and a chapter timeline with captions.
shows: Each step highlights the control to click
Narration, captions and chapters planned up front
Short clips can be cut from the same recording

steps.title: Brief
steps.text: Tell us what you do, who your customers are and what you need. A short form, an email or a WhatsApp message is enough.

steps.title: Scope
steps.text: You get a written scope: deliverables, exclusions, revision rounds, timeline and price. Nothing starts until you approve it.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Work happens in agreed stages, in your own accounts through delegated access. We never ask for passwords.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: You review at agreed points. Consolidated feedback goes into the revision rounds in your scope.

steps.title: Handover
steps.text: Final files and accounts stay in your name. Exactly what you receive is listed in your scope.
